about: Part 2 Task 7, Review Focus 2: the matching engine's output for an event with no groups, recorded from the engine before group rules existed (commit 3d98e241). Eleven people, no groups, two blocks (p02-p07, p06-p11), one inviter and the person they invited (p01-p03), and some history between them. Scores are rounded to 4 places. trioBugIn11 is the same event with the second block on p05-p09 instead, where the old engine sat the blocked pair together in three trios of five rounds.

blockedTrio.about: Five people: the engine pairs p_a-p_b and p_c-p_d and has p_e left over. p_e scores best with p_a and p_b, but p_e blocked p_a. Before the fix the leftover joined p_a-p_b anyway.
